label: Heart Regeneration
summary: Alucard regains 1 heart plus 1 for every 20 total CON each second, including equipment bonuses, without exceeding maximum hearts.

edits.why: HUD MP-regen code: 'lw v0,g_GameTimer' -> 'jal 0x800E2B08' (the cave reloads g_GameTimer into v0)
edits.origin: unattributed (same build as the mp-items gate)

edits.why: Every 60 frames, add floor(total CON / 20) + 1 hearts, capped at maximum; restore the timer for the HUD caller.
edits.origin: Live ASS BIN B478C2A8, correlated with SOTN-ASS2-CON-Heart-Regeneration-manifest.json

vanilla.reason: The hook and unused debug routine match vanilla; the replacement reads the timer, total CON and heart counts from the existing status structure.

overlaps.detail: No byte overlap: mp-items' gate cave starts at 0x42BA0 right after this cave (0x42B9C is unchanged). With this off, 0x42B00-0x42B9B go back to the dead debug function; nothing calls it.

notes: Current version uses total CON at 0x80097BDC including equipment; floor(CON / 20) + 1 every 60 frames. Earlier fixed +2 code remains recognized with its own tunable offsets. Leaving either version checked preserves loaded bytes; removing then re-adding installs the current CON version. HUD pause and disable gating is retained. Adjacent item code at 0x42B9C is outside these edits. Emulator gameplay remains unverified.
